targetMaxHpPct flat-resolves to stat 'maxHpFlat'; asserts grants reach >1 target INCLUDING frima (no except-self clause in the prose), finite expiresFrame, durationShots undefined, >20 applications (per-full-charge, not once-per-battle). Fails under self-scoped, burst-keyed, or round-duration encodings. Paired INERTNESS assertion: stripping it leaves every teammate's total byte-identical (e3 ally-grant rule).

trueDamagePct is a plain percentage stat, so the emitted value must be the literal 28.16 (not flat-resolved); asserts all-allies incl. frima, seconds not rounds, and — the discriminating part — the FIRST application lands after frame 360 (6 full charges at 60 chargeFrames), which is RED under an ungated encoding that fires on the first full charge ~1s in. Counterfactual removing requiresTargetStatus must not DECREASE the application count.

≥1 burst-bucket damage event per frima burstCast, with fbMajorApplied never true — burst-cast damage lands before the Full Burst window opens (verified-facts rule; no +50%). RED under the nearest-wrong fullBurstEnter re-key, which would stamp the FB major and over-credit. Removal counterfactual lowers frima's own total.

fixtures: controlComp('frima', true) — the standard control comp (liter B1 / crown B2 / frima / helm fixed-B3), deterministic, no seed. frima is Burst I, so a real chain requires the B2/B3 partners the control comp supplies; a lone-unit fixture would make ZERO Full Bursts and every burst-slot assertion would be vacuous. The fixed-B3 slot is KEPT (helm) because Full Bursts must actually occur for the burst-cast timing/FB-exemption assertions, and helm's kit touches none of the stats asserted here (trueDamagePct / maxHpFlat / enemy DEF-down), so it cannot forge a green. One hoisted baseline run plus 6 counterfactual runs = 7 total, well under the ~20-run ceiling.
gaps: Sleepy live stack-count trajectory (1→5) — the engine emits maxStacks at apply but no per-frame stack read-out, so the 'landing 6 Full Charges AT MAX stacks' threshold is only observable indirectly via delayed Wake Up onset.
